extraction_notes: The device is identified as an NPN transistor; the function diagram on p. 1 shows pin 1 base, pin 2 collector, and pin 3 emitter.
hFE is bounded by 82 minimum and 390 maximum at IC=0.5 A and VCE=2.0 V, Ta=25 degC. Rank ranges on p. 2 are P=82-180, Q=120-270, and R=180-390.
Absolute maximum ratings on p. 1 include VCEO=50 V, VCBO=60 V, VEBO=6.0 V, IC=2.0 A, and PC=0.5 W, all at Ta=25 degC unless otherwise specified.

Only the p. 2 Fig. 1 static characteristic is retained as compact DC curve evidence. Its three points are direct grid reads from the plotted IB=4.0 mA trace; no intermediate points were interpolated. fT and capacitance plots are omitted as non-DC evidence.
omission_reason: The output is restricted to compact observed DC F2 evidence; only the directly digitized Fig. 1 static characteristic is included, while other plotted characteristics and non-DC data are omitted.
